name: Johannes Groll
headline: Co-Founder & MD at Tacto | We build AI that helps industrial companies stay competitive for the long term
location: New York City, United States of America
summary:
Why AI in procurement? Procurement is the biggest value driver in industry: 50% of costs and 80% of emissions in industrial companies originate here. At the same time, most procurement teams still work with Excel, email, and gut feeling. The growing complexity of parts, suppliers, and supply chains can no longer be managed this way.

 

That's why we're building Tacto: the Procurement Intelligence Platform that connects internal data (ERP data, emails, notes, calls, etc.) with external market data and deploys AI agents to uncover savings potential and automate operational tasks so that procurement teams can finally work strategically.

 

About me: I'm co-founder and managing director of Tacto. What excites me most is working directly with our customers and the potential we can unlock with AI in procurement. Every feature we build, every AI agent, emerges from real conversations and real challenges, always with the shared ambition of actively shaping the procurement of tomorrow. I regularly share practical insights here: what we learn from our customers, the patterns we see in procurement, and which approaches actually work.

positions.description: Tacto is an AI-powered procurement platform for industrial companies. We help manufacturers bring procurement data, supplier management, and sourcing workflows into one system. company.name: Tacto
company.tagline: Stronger Procurement. Stronger Company. Stronger Future.
company.description:
The world is getting more complex and dynamic than ever before. China, climate, elections, trade wars, bureaucracy. Yet manufacturing, our hidden gem, is struggling to evolve. 

Often overlooked: the supply chain. Hundreds of tightly interconnected suppliers, thousands of production-critical parts, global dependencies. Yet procurement is expected to manage this complexity with Excel and Outlook, static ERP systems, and outdated supplier data. That no longer works.

More than 50% of the cost of a physical product is created in the supply chain. Competitive manufacturing therefore starts in procurement. AI offers the opportunity to optimally balance time, cost, and quality in procurement.

That’s why Tacto is building the first Procurement Intelligence Platform for industrial companies: not another workflow tool, but a system that creates transparency, delivers actionable recommendations, and enables execution - with procurement as the decision-maker at the center.

Powered by Tacto Intelligence, you see your procurement operations at a glance: KPIs, suppliers, and real-time order and material movements. In the background, Tacto connects your ERP data with external market data to form the Procurement Brain. On top of that, AI agents automate manual work, identify risks and savings opportunities, and provide precise recommendations. Automated workflows turn these signals into action - delivering measurable results: lower costs, better quality, and higher availability.
